bio.text: Brian Strickland, a Republican state senator from McDonough, won the May 19, 2026 Republican primary for Georgia attorney general over Bill Cowsert and is the Republican nominee in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Tanya Miller.
He served in the Georgia House of Representatives from 2013 to 2017 and was elected to the Georgia Senate in 2018; he is a lawyer and chairs the Senate Judiciary Committee.
According to Ballotpedia, he earned a business degree in economics from Valdosta State University in 2006 and a law degree from Florida Coastal School of Law in 2009.
